name: Fuwa Kento
source:
One of the members of X.I.P.

A former magazine model recruited by Kyoya. He acts as the group's "wild" member and is also a 4-dan kendo practitioner.

Although Kento is generally kind and sensitive, his stoic expression makes it hard for people to interact with him. He also has an unusual fear of dogs.

[from [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Tokimeki_Restaurant%E2%98%86%E2%98%86%E2%98%86]Koei Wikia[/url]]
